name: HorizonX Web2 Demo Dataset
purpose: Curated local demo catalog for Web2 ecosystem UI, relational navigation, search, filtering, pagination, and image-loading QA.
provenance: All catalog records and market-like values are illustrative demo data. They are not live market feeds, endorsements, verified projects, or on-chain state.
imagePolicy: Every image, bannerImage, coverImage, and galleryImages value in the catalog uses the same local placeholder asset. Replace these fields with real artwork later.

relationships.projects.tokenIds: Each token ID must resolve to tokens.id.
relationships.projects.partnerIds: Each partner ID must resolve to partners.id.
relationships.tokens.projectId: Each project ID must resolve to projects.id.
relationships.presales.projectId/tokenId: Each projectId and tokenId must resolve to projects.id and tokens.id.
relationships.fair-launches.projectId/tokenId: Each projectId and tokenId must resolve to projects.id and tokens.id.
relationships.airdrops.projectId/tokenId: Each projectId and tokenId must resolve to projects.id and tokens.id.
relationships.staking-pools.projectId/tokenId: Each projectId and tokenId must resolve to projects.id and tokens.id.

notes: Dataset expanded to three coherent cohorts: original records plus Cohort II and Cohort III variants.
Every cohort uses remapped IDs so cross-collection relationships resolve within its own cohort.
All records are illustrative demo content; no external Web2 APIs are required.
All image, banner, cover, and gallery fields use the same local placeholder asset.
Partner .example URLs are reserved placeholders, not real websites.
